name: Scrying

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

components.m: a focus worth 1,000+ GP, such as a crystal ball, mirror or font of water

targets.description: a creature you choose on the same plane

summary: Spy on a creature on your plane through an invisible sensor: Wis save resists.
text: The save is easier or harder by how well you know the target and what connects you to it. On a failure an invisible sensor follows within 10 ft of it, and you see and hear through it; you can instead spy on a place you've seen.
